summary: REQ-013.2.2 unverified: covering tests in tests/evidence-groups.test.ts never observe the declared-globs hash part — every review-ID change they detect (evidence-scope edit, group removal, e2e removal) is confounded with matched-file-content/group-existence changes; mutation-verified: deleting the evidence-group:*#decl part from evidenceGroupParts (src/review.ts) leaves both REQ-013.2.2 covering tests green, so a declaration-only mapping edit (e.g. changing a group's tests globs or an equivalent-matching evidence glob) would not invalidate dependent verdicts
